page.layout: One page of text: verse in stanzas of four lines, set full width. Catchword "Et" at the right, below the last line.

main_text.p: Nam Deus fastu nimio feroces Deprimet tandem, minuetq; vires, At suo reddet stabilem piorum Numine sortem.
Terminum his vitæ statuit, diesq; Usq; ad extremam numerat senectam, Atq; inexhausto sinit ut fruantur Fonte bonorum.
Non malis presi uarijs satiscent, Spes nec illorum pudefiet unquam[?], Nec sames totis metuenda terris Opprimet illos.
Rursus iniusti genus interibit, Et Deum quisquis vitijs[?] lacesset, Illius tandem referet fugaces Gloria fumos.
Semper est iusto super unde donet, Semper iniustis comes est egestas: Mutuum sumunt avidi, nec unquam[?] Soluere curant.
At quibus præsto sauor est supremi Numinis, terræ domini manebunt, Huius expertes: penitus recisa Stirpe peribunt.
Ille iustorum regit usq; gressus, Ille cunctarum comes est viarum, Illius cunctos prohibere prompta est Dextera lapsus.

page.notes: Verse spelling is normalised as printed except for u/v and long s. The reading of "unquam" (lines 3 and 5) and "vitijs" (line 2 of the fourth stanza) is doubtful because of the ink and the scan. The running head is absent. The page number 318 is printed at the top with the 8 set high. "Nam" at the start of the page appears in heavier type, not italic.
